name: Cú Chulainn
style: The Hound of Ulster: the longest reach of the spearmen and quick feet, so he pokes from outside your range, then closes in with a lunge or a leaping spear.

moves.name: Spear Combo
moves.notes: Three thrusts with long reach. The third steps further in and hits hardest, knocking the foe back and up.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.notes: Ground only. Hold HEAVY to charge, then let go to lunge across the arena. The damage grows with the charge (full charge takes about 0.8 s). A quick tap is the light combo instead.

moves.name: Rising Spear
moves.notes: A rising swing that pops the foe up to float in the air. Jump after it connects to chase them into the air thrusts.

moves.name: Air Thrusts
moves.notes: Two quick jabs keep a floating foe close, then a finisher knocks them down. HEAVY in the air plays the same string. He has no air plunge.

moves.name: Spear Throw
moves.notes: Grabs a grounded foe in front of him within reach. The foe can break free by pressing LIGHT or HEAVY within the first 8 ticks (about 0.13 s).

moves.name: Salmon Leap
moves.notes: His signature special: a fast, soaring vault over the foe, spear first. It hits once as he passes and launches them. 6 second cooldown.

moves.name: Gáe Bulg
moves.notes: The Rift Art: the barbed spear's unstoppable lunge across the arena. No guard stops it: only a perfect block parries it.

moves.name: Pole Vault
moves.notes: A leap up and over the foe on his spear, along the stick. Invulnerable for its first 11 ticks (about 0.2 s). On the ground it has a cooldown; in the air it uses his one air-dash charge.

combos.name: Launch and chase
combos.notes: The rising spear pops the foe up, then he jumps after them and finishes with the air thrusts. Each hit after the first in a string deals less (7% per hit, down to 40%), so the listed numbers are the first-hit values.

combos.name: Thrusts into lunge
combos.notes: Two thrusts to get the foe in front of him, then charge the lunge for the big hit. Release the charge after about a quarter second and it becomes the light combo.

combos.name: Thrusts into leap
combos.notes: Chain straight from the last thrust into Salmon Leap, which launches the foe as a finish. Salmon Leap has a 6 second cooldown, so save it for a clean hit.
